title: You already speak Spanish (-al words)
concept: Cold-start hook clip. The English -al/-ble cognate rule: same spelling, stress the final syllable, clean Spanish vowels. Pick the most instantly-recognizable words so the 'I already know this' feeling is maximal.
voice_notes: Patient Language Transfer teacher. Warm, slow, unhurried. Tiny pause before each answer.

hook.say: You already speak Spanish. You just don't know it yet.
hook.show_sub: you just don't know it yet

lead_in.say: Hundreds of English words are almost identical in Spanish. Just move the stress to the end.
lead_in.show_sub: move the emphasis to the end

outro.say: That's hundreds of words you already know. Follow for the free course.

caption: You already speak Spanish — you just don't know it yet 🤯 Same words, just move the stress to the end. Say them out loud: animal, hospital, capital, natural.
